items.title: Can AI Make On-Demand Healthcare More Human? Here's What's Changing | Experity CTO
items.summary: AI is taking repetitive work off healthcare teams' plates, giving providers more time with patients and helping clinics deliver a more connected on-demand healthcare experience. In this episode of Simulated Reality, Saji Rajasekharan, CTO of Experity, explains how AI is being built into urgent care, from AI scribes that listen to patient conversations to AI agents supporting revenue cycle management and patient engagement. He breaks down how these technologies can give providers more time and attention for patients while helping clinics operate more efficiently. We also go deep on why healthcare AI can never work without a human in the loop, what it takes to build clinical technology patients and doctors actually trust, and why India is not just supporting this work: teams in Bengaluru are owning and building core products for American healthcare. Saji Rajasekharan is CTO of Experity, where he leads engineering for the company's AI platform building the operating system for on-demand urgent care, from back-office workflows to the patient experience. 00:00 Why healthcare is recession proof 01:03 Meet Saji Rajasekharan, CTO of Experity 01:34 What on-demand healthcare means 03:03 Automating revenue cycle management 04:02 AI Scribe and documentation time 06:01 Care Agent and patient engagement 07:47 Getting clinicians to adopt AI 09:35 Tesla self-drive and building trust 10:49 Why a human stays in the loop 12:13 The complexity of urgent care 13:47 Discharge instructions that cut call volumes 16:11 Exdion acquisition and the Bengaluru team 17:44 The traits Experity hires for 23:29 Education in India and the US 31:40 Experity's goals for AI in on-demand care #AIinHealthcare #Experity #UrgentCare #SimulatedReality #AIMNetwork ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 📌 Note: The video thumbnail is for representational purposes and was created with the assistance of AI. 📩 For inquiries or questions, contact us at: info@aimmediahouse.com ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 📌 ABOUT FRONT PAGE Front Page is a daily live news briefing covering AI, enterprise tech, semiconductors, and India’s role in the global technology economy. items.title: I Tracked Every Mistake My AI Race Engineer Made (Agent Lens) | Part 2
items.summary: I built an AI race engineer for F1 25 Time Trial at Las Vegas, running on a local Qwen model. In Part 2, I go through everything Agent Lens captured from my sessions: conversations, turns, the race coach and race engineer agents, and the failure patterns it found, like tool misuse and lost context. I also use ARIA in CoreWeave Forge to tag the moments I got frustrated. Next, I’m turning those insights into a dataset to fine-tune the model.
